plan.notes: Plan intro states 77-78 major-specific credits and a 120-credit university minimum; the published term layout encodes to 78 credits at the standard (lower-bound) calculus choices. GE is selected by the student around the published major courses, so only the major courses appear in this plan. MATH 110 (3 cr) OR MATH 115 (4 cr) in Y1 Fall; encoded MATH 110 with choice_note. MATH 111 (3 cr) OR MATH 116 (4 cr) in Y1 Spring; encoded MATH 111 with choice_note. MATH 210 carries the plan footnote '* Not required for those who took MATH 116'; encoded as a choice slot with that note. 5 'Software Engineering Upper Division Requirement' and 3 'Software Engineering Elective' slots are genuine named requirement slots from the plan; student selects specific courses with advisor. Per-slot prereqs are not published on the 4-year plan page; prereq arrays are intentionally empty (see catalog course pages for details). CPSC 298 (Computer Science Colloquium, 1 credit) is genuinely repeated in three semesters with different topics (Intro to *Nix; any topic; C++ Programming) per the official plan; allow_repeated_courses is set. Source: official Chapman University 2024-2025 Undergraduate Catalog, '' (Suggested 4-Year Plan). https://catalog.chapman.edu/preview_program.php?catoid=46&poid=9857 The catalog states a minimum of None credits to graduate and None major-specific credits for this degree; the plan page publishes major courses by term only — General Education/minor courses are selected by the student around this plan, so total_credits (78) is the sum of the published major-course slots, not the 120-credit degree minimum. Per-slot prerequisites are not published on the 4-year plan page, so prereq arrays are intentionally empty; see the catalog's course descriptions for official prerequisites. Variable-credit courses are encoded at the source lower bound with the range documented in choice_note.
